title: A string literal under `as class<T>` is the class's whole name, loaded through `autoload` and checked while compiling
scope:
Which operands of `as class<T>` and `as ?class<T>` the compiler decides, how a string literal
names its class, and that the literal loads the class through `autoload`. A value built at run time,
and what editor completion offers inside the literal, are not decided here.
dependsOnText:
[0125](0125.md) (`class<T>`, and its `Foo::class` operand decided at compile time),
[0061](0061.md) (a name reaches its file while compiling, and no loader runs at run time).
